urdu: مریم صفدر نے محمد صفدر اعوان سے شادی کب کی؟
english: When did Maryam Safdar marry Muhammad Safdar Awan?
roman_1: Mariam Safdar ne Muhammad Safdar Awan se shadi kab ki?
roman_2: Maryum Safdar nay Mohd Safdar Awan se shaadi kab ki?
roman_3: Mareem Safdar nay Muhammad Safdar Awan say shadi kab ki?
